支持多种 RAW，但部分 CR3、NEF 和压缩 ORF 只回退到内嵌 JPEG: Supports multiple RAW formats, but some CR3, NEF and compressed ORF variants fall back to embedded JPEG; check the camera model.

真实 AI 文件往返和部分实时效果仍有限制；不保证 Illustrator 或: Real-world AI round trips and some live effects remain limited; lossless Illustrator or Affinity interchange is not guaranteed.

实时会话为预览功能，没有完整账号和团队体系。: Live sessions are a preview without a complete account or team system.
可自托管 figcraft-server 预览版；分享链接或代码即访问凭据。: A preview figcraft-server can be self-hosted; sharing links or codes grant access.
FIG 导入为尽力兼容。在线分享会上传文件且不是端到端加密；本地网络分享也不加密: FIG import is best-effort. Online sharing uploads files and is not end-to-end encrypted; local-network sharing is also unencrypted.

Rust 非线性视频编辑器，处于 alpha；具备多轨剪辑、调色、关键帧与字幕。: Rust nonlinear video editor in alpha, with multitrack editing, grading, keyframes and captions.

Rust 离线 PDF 阅读与编辑工具，处于 alpha；阅读、批注和页面整理之: Rust offline PDF reader and editor in alpha; professional workflows beyond reading, annotation and page organization need validation.
复杂印前、字体和格式交换需逐项验证，不保证 InDesign 文件无损往返。: Complex prepress, fonts and interchange require individual validation; lossless InDesign round trips are not guaranteed.

面向 AI Agent 的浏览器自动化 CLI，通过快照引用执行导航、点击与输入: A browser-automation CLI for AI agents, using snapshot references for navigation, clicks and input; not an autonomous planning model or a new browser engine.
Apache-2.0 CLI 可免费使用；调用它的 Agent 模型、云浏览器和: The Apache-2.0 CLI is free to use; the calling agent model, cloud browser and proxy are charged separately by the chosen providers.
需安装运行环境和浏览器，默认使用 Chrome for Testing；可通过: Requires a runtime and browser; Chrome for Testing is the default. CDP can connect an existing browser. 需显式选择本地 chromium 或 chrome 模式: Explicitly select local chromium or chrome mode
chrome 模式连接已开 Chrome: chrome mode connects an open Chrome instance
读取页面状态供 Agent 决策: Reads page state for agent decisions
由配置的模型驱动多步 Agent 任务: The configured model drives multi-step agent tasks
1.x 默认 Cloud，显式本地模式可替换: Cloud is the 1.x default; explicit local modes are available
Python 浏览器 Agent 框架，将模型与页面操作连接；开源库、Cloud: A Python browser-agent framework connecting models with page actions; the open-source library, Cloud browsers and hosted agents are distinct products.
MIT 库免费。1.x 默认使用模型网关与云浏览器；模型、搜索、浏览器时长及代理: The MIT library is free. Version 1.x defaults to a model gateway and cloud browser; models, search, browser time and proxies are separate costs. cost_usd excludes cloud browser and proxy charges.
1.x 的 Browser() 默认 Cloud；Browser('chromi: In 1.x, Browser() defaults to Cloud; Browser('chromium') launches a temporary local profile and Browser('chrome') connects an open Chrome instance. Model and account credentials must be configured; local browsing does not imply local model processing. When telemetry is enabled, some library authentication and startup events are recorded. Live-view links grant session control and must not be public.
既有登录会话复用需按具体版本与配置核实: Existing signed-in session reuse needs version-specific verification
自然语言操作与 Agent 能力可在代码中编排: Natural-language actions and agent capabilities can be composed in code
可使用 Browserbase，托管费用独立: Can use Browserbase; hosting is billed separately
AI 浏览器自动化 SDK，在代码中组合页面操作与数据提取；不是 Browser: An AI browser-automation SDK combining page actions and data extraction in code; it is not the Browserbase hosted-browser service itself.
MIT SDK 免费；模型推理与 Browserbase 等浏览器托管费用另计。: The MIT SDK is free; model inference and browser hosting such as Browserbase are billed separately. An open-source SDK does not make the hosted service free or self-hostable.
需要开发环境、浏览器和模型配置；可选本地或 Browserbase。页面上下文会: Requires a development environment, browser and model configuration; local execution or Browserbase can be selected. Page context is transmitted according to the chosen model and runtime. Check model-provider and hosting logs, retention and permissions separately; not benchmarked here.
扩展连接现有标签，或使用持久 profile: Extension connects existing tabs; persistent profiles are also supported
使用可访问性快照，不要求视觉模型: Uses accessibility snapshots without requiring a vision model
MCP 客户端与模型负责规划，服务器执行工具: The MCP client and model plan; the server executes tools
为 MCP 客户端暴露 Playwright 浏览器工具的服务器，以可访问性快照: A server exposing Playwright browser tools to MCP clients, using accessibility snapshots for model-driven actions; no LLM is bundled.
Apache-2.0 服务器免费；MCP 客户端、模型 API 和远程浏览器的费: The Apache-2.0 server is free; MCP client, model API and remote-browser costs depend on the selected services.
默认持久 profile 会保留登录状态；--isolated 使用内存 pro: The default persistent profile retains logins. --isolated uses an in-memory profile discarded on close, optionally seeded with storage state. Extension mode connects existing tabs. Concurrent use of one profile conflicts. allowed-origins / blocked-origins are not security boundaries and do not affect redirects; they do not replace network isolation.
SendGrid Email API 的免费试用仅 60 天、每天 100 封；: SendGrid Email API offers only a 60-day trial with 100 emails/day; continued sending requires an upgrade, not a permanent free plan.
自注册日起仅一次试用，每天 100 封，按 UTC 次日重置；无需信用卡。升级会: One trial from signup: 100 emails/day, resetting the next day in UTC; no credit card required. Upgrading ends the trial immediately and it cannot restart.
试用日限超出返回 Maximum credits exceeded；60 天后须: Trial daily-limit exhaustion returns Maximum credits exceeded. After 60 days, upgrade Email API to continue sending; Marketing Campaigns is separate. Mainland China signup eligibility and production approval requirements are unverified; no account or sending test was performed.
支持 API 与 SMTP 事务邮件发送；Email API 和 Marketi: Supports API and SMTP transactional sending; Email API and Marketing Campaigns upgrade independently, so a marketing subscription is not an API allowance.
每个新账户仅一次 60 天试用，自注册日起计，每天最多 100 封；UTC 次日: Each new account has one 60-day trial from signup, up to 100 emails/day, resetting the next day in UTC; not 3,000 emails/month or permanent free usage.
必须验证发件身份；可验证单个发件人，或用 DNS 做域名认证。域名数量上限未核实: Sender identity must be verified through single-sender verification or DNS domain authentication. Domain-count limits are unverified; sender verification is not production approval.
是否另需生产审批及地区资格未核实，不能承诺注册后即可向任意收件人发送。: Separate production approval and regional eligibility are unverified; signup does not guarantee unrestricted sending.
官方明确免费试用无需信用卡；升级付费方案需添加支付方式，免卡不免除发件验证。: The official trial requires no credit card; paid upgrades require a payment method. Cardless signup does not waive sender verification.
试用每日 100 封用尽后返回 Maximum credits exceeded: After the 100-message daily trial limit, Maximum credits exceeded requires waiting for the next UTC day; trial expiry requires an Email API upgrade. Queueing, retry and carryover are unverified; automatic redelivery is not guaranteed.
源码可见的插件式键盘启动器，支持 Linux 与 macOS；采用限制用途与再分: A source-available, plugin-based keyboard launcher for Linux and macOS, under a custom license restricting use and redistribution.
个人使用免费；企业或商业用途许可未确认，不能据源码公开推定获准。: Free for personal use; permission for business or commercial use is unconfirmed and must not be inferred from public source availability.
许可允许个人使用及修改，但不授予修改版再分发权。未修改版再分发须保留声明；二进制: The license permits personal use and modification, but does not grant redistribution of modified versions. Unmodified redistribution must retain notices; binary redistribution must not target Microsoft or Apple platforms. This is not a ban on personal macOS use.
原生浏览器闭源；JavaScript SDK 与 Skill 仓库为 MIT: Native browser is closed source; the JavaScript SDK and Skill repository is MIT-licensed
个人免费；企业定制: Free for individuals; custom business pricing
个人版浏览器免费；Business 定制报价，第三方 Agent、模型和网络费用: The browser is free for individuals; Business has custom pricing. Third-party agent, model and network costs are separate.
CitroLabs 的 Chromium 协作浏览器：用户日常浏览，外部 Age: A Chromium-based collaborative browser from CitroLabs: users browse normally while external agents perform tasks in their own Spaces.
Space 分离任务页面，不自动隔离 Profile、登录或网站权限；同一 Pr: Spaces separate task pages, not automatically Profiles, logins or website permissions; personal tabs and Spaces on the same Profile share cookies and cache. Browser data is stored locally, but page text and screenshots may be sent to the chosen model. MIT covers only the public SDK/Skill, not the separately supplied native browser; this is distinct from the waitlisted ego.app personal agent.
通过外部 Agent 读取页面并问答，不是浏览器自带生成式 AI。: Page reading and chat use an external agent, not built-in generative AI.
外部 Agent 可在 Space 中管理多个任务页面；跨页推理能力取决于 Ag: External agents can manage multiple task pages in Spaces; cross-page reasoning depends on the agent.
外部 Agent 经 ego-browser 执行点击、填表等操作；需用户授权与: External agents use ego-browser for actions such as clicking and form filling, subject to user authorization and account checks.
通过兼容的外部 Agent 配置模型；不等于浏览器默认在本地推理。: Models are configured through compatible external agents; the browser does not perform local inference by default.
需要在同一电脑运行具备命令执行能力的外部 Agent。macOS 与 Windo: Requires an external agent able to execute commands on the same computer. Available on macOS and Windows, with Linux on the roadmap; a free browser does not mean free model calls. 跨平台数据库客户端，提供 SQL 查询、数据网格、结构查看及导入导出，可选择桌面: A cross-platform database client with SQL queries, data grids, schema browsing, and import/export, available as a desktop app or self-hosted web app.
DBX 软件免费开源，采用 Apache-2.0；数据库托管、外部 AI API: DBX is free and open source under Apache-2.0; database hosting, external AI APIs, and self-hosting infrastructure costs are not included.
各引擎与驱动能力不同，数据编辑取决于可识别行和数据库权限；Web 文件路径属于服: Capabilities vary by engine and driver; data editing depends on identifiable rows and database privileges. Web file paths belong to the server. Before enabling AI or MCP, verify targets, permissions, and outgoing context. Open source does not mean fully offline or automatically read-only.
分析网络接口或捕获文件中的数据包，不等同 HTTP 调试代理。仅采集自有或获授权: Analyze packets from network interfaces or capture files, rather than acting as an HTTP debugging proxy. Capture only traffic you own or are authorized to inspect; sanitize captures before sharing because they may contain credentials and personal data.
图形化网络协议分析器，可查看实时或已保存的数据包，并提供 TShark 命令行工: A graphical network protocol analyzer for live and saved packets, with the TShark command-line tool.
Wireshark 免费开源；捕获驱动等第三方组件适用各自许可。: Wireshark is free and open source; third-party components such as capture drivers have their own licenses.
采集依赖操作系统、接口、驱动和权限；TLS 等加密流量需要适用的密钥或会话秘密，: Capture depends on the OS, interface, drivers and permissions. Encrypted traffic such as TLS requires applicable keys or session secrets; capturing packets alone does not decrypt it.
基于 libpcap 的命令行抓包工具，用过滤表达式选择数据包，支持保存和读取捕: A libpcap-based command-line capture tool with packet filter expressions and capture-file reading and writing.
tcpdump 免费开源；依赖库和 Windows 捕获驱动适用各自许可。: tcpdump is free and open source; libraries and Windows capture drivers have their own licenses.
没有内置图形界面；采集通常需要额外权限。Windows 官方源码构建依赖 Vis: No built-in GUI; capture commonly requires additional privileges. Official Windows source builds require Visual Studio, CMake and WinPcap or Npcap, not necessarily a ready-to-install official Windows package.
通过调试代理检查应用请求，不等同网络数据包分析或 VPN。仅调试自有或获授权流量: Inspect application requests through a debugging proxy, distinct from packet analysis or a VPN. Debug only traffic you own or are authorized to inspect. HTTPS requires client certificate trust; certificate pinning or app configuration may prevent decryption. Captures and replays can expose secrets or change server data.
开源交互式 HTTPS 调试代理，提供终端、mitmweb 界面及 Python: An open-source interactive HTTPS debugging proxy with terminal and mitmweb interfaces, Python extensions, traffic editing and replay.
mitmproxy 本体免费开源，无按席位订阅费。: mitmproxy itself is free and open source, without a per-seat subscription fee.
目标设备需正确路由到代理并信任其 CA；证书固定的应用可能拒绝连接。移动端是被调: Target devices must route traffic through the proxy and trust its CA; certificate-pinned apps may reject connections. Mobile devices are debug targets, not standalone mobile editors.
桌面 HTTP 调试代理，提供 SSL 检查、请求编辑重放和本地响应映射。: A desktop HTTP debugging proxy with SSL inspection, request editing and replay, and local response mapping.
Charles 单用户许可标价 US$50，覆盖购买时的大版本；后续大版本升级可: Charles lists a single-user license at US$50 for the purchased major version; later major upgrades may cost extra, with regional taxes added.
提供 30 天试用，不是永久免费版。Android 应用可能需配置对用户 CA: A 30-day trial is available, not a permanently free edition. Android apps may need configuration to trust user CAs; do not assume the desktop license includes the separate iOS app.
跨平台桌面 HTTP 调试代理，提供断点、请求重放及 Map Local；另有独: A cross-platform desktop HTTP debugging proxy with breakpoints, request replay and Map Local; separate mobile apps are also available.
个人永久许可含一年更新，可继续使用已获版本；团队另有按年计费订阅，移动席位随套餐: Individual perpetual licenses include one year of updates and continued use of the acquired version; teams also have annual subscriptions, with mobile seats varying by plan.
可免费开始使用；完整 SSL Proxying、断点和 Map Local 列为: Free to start; full SSL Proxying, breakpoints and Map Local are listed as premium features. All trial limits were not verified, so do not assume unlimited free use; capabilities can differ by platform.
开源 HTTP 调试工具，提供桌面流量检查与断点，支持 Android 辅助接入: An open-source HTTP debugging tool with desktop traffic inspection and breakpoints, assisted Android setup and manual iOS proxy configuration.
Hobbyist 免费，Pro 与 Team 提供订阅功能；开源代码不等于官方付: Hobbyist is free, with Pro and Team subscription features; open-source code does not make official paid features subscription-free. Check current checkout for exact prices.
免费档支持检查和手动断点修改；自动模拟、重放及流量导入导出属 Pro。非 roo: The free tier supports inspection and manual breakpoint edits; automated mocking, replay and traffic import/export require Pro. Your own apps on unrooted Android may need CA trust configuration; iOS needs manual proxy and certificate trust setup, without guaranteed decryption of every app.
比较原生移动应用开发环境，不混入跨平台框架。平台字段表示运行 IDE 的电脑系统: Native mobile app development environments, separate from cross-platform frameworks. Platforms are IDE host operating systems, not app targets; emulator, SDK and device support varies by version and hardware. Free tools do not imply free store distribution or unlimited cloud services.
Google 官方 Android IDE，基于 IntelliJ，集成 Gra: Google’s official Android IDE, based on IntelliJ, with Gradle builds, Android Emulator, UI previews and debugging/testing tools.
本地 IDE 可免费下载使用；Gemini 等服务存在免费与付费档，Google: The local IDE is free to download and use; services such as Gemini have free and paid tiers. Google Play publishing accounts and other cloud services are outside the free IDE scope.
面向 Android，而非本地 iOS 构建工具链。ChromeOS 需 Lin: Targets Android, not a local iOS build toolchain. ChromeOS requires Linux support; the installation guide currently limits deployment there to connected physical devices. Emulators have additional hardware requirements. Open-source IDE components do not place SDKs, Google APIs or cloud services under one open-source license.
Apple 官方开发环境，在 Mac 上为 iOS、iPadOS 等 Apple: Apple’s official development environment, running on Mac to build apps for iOS, iPadOS and other Apple platforms, with Simulator, UI previews, debuggers and testing tools.
Xcode 可从 Mac App Store 免费获取；App Store 分发: Xcode is free from the Mac App Store. App Store distribution normally requires a paid developer program; Xcode Cloud and third-party AI services have separate eligibility, quotas or charges.
宿主仅 macOS，不能据此认定 Windows/Linux 可本地构建 iOS: The host is macOS only, not local iOS builds on Windows/Linux. Free-account device testing has signing and capability limits; some SDKs, simulators and AI features require specific Mac hardware and OS versions. Xcode itself is proprietary, distinct from open-source Swift.
比较应用框架，不是 IDE 或云构建订阅。平台字段为开发宿主；Android/i: Application frameworks, not IDEs or cloud-build subscriptions. Platforms are development hosts; Android/iOS are primary app targets. Shared code does not guarantee plugin parity. Local iOS builds still require macOS and Xcode; store distribution and third-party services are separate.
使用 Dart 的跨平台 UI 框架，以自身渲染引擎绘制组件，支持移动、Web: A cross-platform UI framework using Dart and its own rendering engine, supporting mobile, web and desktop apps with native platform integration.
Flutter 框架免费开源；引擎依赖、插件各有许可，商店账号、后端及第三方构建: The Flutter framework is free and open source. Engine dependencies and plugins have their own licenses; store accounts, backends and third-party build services may cost extra.
热重载面向开发流程，不是向已发布应用推送代码；原生代码修改通常需重新构建。各宿主: Hot reload is a development workflow, not code delivery to published apps; native code changes generally require rebuilding. Build targets vary by host, and local iOS builds require a Mac. Check plugins and desktop/web adaptations individually.
通过 React 与 JavaScript/TypeScript 构建 Andr: Build Android/iOS apps with React and JavaScript/TypeScript. Core components map to native UI, with native modules extending platform capabilities.
React Native 核心按 MIT 免费开源；Expo 等框架可辅助开发，: React Native core is free and open source under MIT. Frameworks such as Expo can assist development, but optional cloud builds, hosting and store accounts are not core free entitlements.
Web 与 Windows/macOS 等桌面目标依赖树外项目，不等于核心开箱即: Web and desktop targets such as Windows/macOS rely on out-of-tree projects, not core out-of-the-box support or full feature parity. Fast Refresh does not preserve every state. Local iOS builds require Xcode/macOS; cloud workflows do not change that local requirement.
官方帮助说明：个人免费档保留一个月历史版本，个人付费档保留三个月；不是永久保留。: Official help states one month of version history for free personal accounts and three months for paid personal accounts; retention is not permanent.
仅适用于支持的文件：压缩及多数加密文件不支持，官方将加密 Office 文件列为: Applies only to supported files: compressed and most encrypted files are excluded, with encrypted Office files listed as an exception; mobile apps do not support incremental sync.
支持同一局域网客户端间加速分发，但文件仍须先上传云服务器；不是完全离线、无需云端: Supports accelerated distribution between clients on the same LAN, but files must first upload to cloud servers; this is not fully offline, cloud-free P2P sync.
发生冲突时保留云端文件，并将本地修改另存为冲突副本；内容不同仍需人工比对、合并，: Keeps the cloud file and saves local changes as a conflict copy; differing contents still require manual comparison and merging, not automatic content merging.
Windows 客户端支持用户设定忽略规则，使匹配的文件或文件夹不同步；规则语法: The Windows client supports user-defined ignore rules that exclude matching files or folders from sync; rule syntax and equivalent configuration on other platforms are unverified.
内置实验性调试命令，支持启动调试、断点、步进和变量查看；不代表所有语言开箱即用或: Built-in experimental debugging commands support launching, breakpoints, stepping and variable inspection; this does not imply out-of-the-box support for every language or mature IDE-level debugging.
已实现 DAP 调试；运行配置须指定调试器类型，否则只能运行，不能调试。不代表所: Implements DAP debugging; the run configuration must specify a debugger type, otherwise it can only run, not debug. This does not imply out-of-the-box support for every language.
需安装并启用 GeanyVC 插件，调用 Git 工具链提供差异、日志、状态及提: Requires the GeanyVC plugin to be installed and enabled; it invokes the Git toolchain for diff, log, status, commit and related actions, rather than providing a complete built-in Git GUI.
通过 LSP Client 插件提供，语言服务器须另行安装和配置，默认需按项目启: Provided through the LSP Client plugin; language servers must be installed and configured separately, with per-project activation required by default. Features depend on server support.
通过 Debugger 插件提供断点、变量监视和调用栈；已核实版本仅支持 GDB: The Debugger plugin provides breakpoints, watches and stack inspection; the verified version supports only GDB and requires libvte, GTK 3 and POSIX APIs, rather than being bundled on every platform.
可选 gitstatus 插件调用外部 Git 显示分支、增删行数并标记修改文件: The optional gitstatus plugin invokes external Git to show the branch, added/deleted line counts and modified-file indicators; this plugin is not a complete commit or branch-management GUI.
编辑器内置向上/向下添加光标及移除最后一个光标的操作；不是仅指符号重命名或跨文件: The editor includes actions to add carets above or below and remove the last caret; this is not merely symbol renaming or cross-file replacement.
提供 LSP 客户端接入能力，需相应语言集成及语言服务器；不等于所有语言开箱即用: Provides LSP client integration with the corresponding language integration and server; this is not out-of-the-box support for every language, nor the same as providing a Java LSP server to other editors.
提供 IDE 内本地终端，但须满足系统 PTY 支持条件；Windows 缺少支: Provides a local terminal inside the IDE, subject to system PTY support; on Windows the implementation prompts for Cygwin when support is missing, so it is not zero-configuration on every platform.
通过可选 lsp 插件和外部语言服务器提供基础能力；插件仍属概念验证，部分修改事: Basic support via the optional lsp plugin and external language servers; the plugin remains a proof of concept, misses some modification events, and re-synchronizes on save.
支持矩形选区列编辑及零宽列选区多行插入；此处仅确认列编辑，不推断任意不连续位置的: Supports rectangular column editing and multi-line insertion with zero-width column selections; only column editing is verified here, not arbitrary discontiguous cursors.
Grab Text 可提取图片文字；Windows 旧 OCR 引擎须更新至 2: Grab Text extracts text from images; the legacy Windows OCR engine needs 2026.1.1, 2025.4.2, 2024.3.7 or later updates in the respective branch to refresh its license. Versions 2023 and older receive no such update. Accuracy depends on the image.
比较构建命令行应用的开发库，不是 AI 编程 CLI 或终端模拟器。平台表示开发: Libraries for building command-line applications, not AI coding CLIs or terminal emulators. Platforms denote development and runtime hosts; the relevant toolchain or runtime is still required. Shell completion requires script installation or activation. Open-source frameworks do not make applications, dependencies, distribution or external services universally free.
开发库免费开源；依赖各有许可，应用分发、托管和第三方服务费用另计。: The development library is free and open source; dependencies have their own licenses. Application distribution, hosting and third-party services may cost extra.
已核实来源未确认核心库提供此能力，不代表整个语言生态不支持。: The reviewed sources do not confirm this capability in the core library; this does not rule out support elsewhere in the language ecosystem.
额外使用官方 clap_complete crate。: Requires the separate official clap_complete crate.
Go 命令行应用库，提供命令树、参数与标志解析、帮助和补全生成。: Go library for command-line applications with command trees, arguments and flags, help and completion generation.
需 Go 工具链构建；支持生成 Bash、Zsh、Fish 和 PowerShe: Requires the Go toolchain to build. Generates Bash, Zsh, Fish and PowerShell completion scripts and supports dynamic completion callbacks. Generating scripts does not install them in the user’s shell.
Rust 参数解析库，支持构建器或可选 derive 宏定义 CLI，并生成帮助: Rust argument parser with a builder API or optional derive macros for defining CLIs, help and subcommands.
需 Rust 工具链构建；Shell 补全由独立 clap_complete c: Requires the Rust toolchain to build. Shell completion uses the separate clap_complete crate; static script generation and dynamic completion have distinct feature flags and support boundaries.
Node.js 命令行解析库，以 JavaScript API 定义选项、位置参: Node.js command-line parser with JavaScript APIs for options, positional arguments, subcommands and automatic help, plus TypeScript types.
需兼容版本的 Node.js。参数解析不等于交互式问答或 Shell 补全；这两: Requires a compatible Node.js version. Argument parsing is not interactive prompting or shell completion; the reviewed core documentation does not establish either as built in.
Python 装饰器式命令行工具包，支持嵌套命令、参数转换、自动帮助及输入确认。: Decorator-based Python command-line toolkit with nested commands, parameter conversion, automatic help and input confirmation.
需 Python 运行时。Shell 补全要求通过已安装的入口命令调用并在 Sh: Requires Python. Shell completion requires an installed entry-point command and shell activation, not simply running python script.py. Prompts are not a full interactive line editor.
基于 Python 类型提示定义命令行参数的框架，支持命令组、自动帮助、Shel: Framework using Python type hints to define CLI parameters, with command groups, automatic help, shell completion and input confirmation.
需 Python 运行时；自动推断参数不替代业务校验。Shell 补全需要安装到: Requires Python; inferred parameters do not replace business validation. Shell completion must be installed for the relevant shell and can use callbacks for candidates. Input prompts are distinct from a full TUI.
面向 Node.js 的 CLI 框架，以命令类、参数标志和插件组织应用，支持: Node.js CLI framework organizing applications around command classes, arguments, flags and plugins, supporting JavaScript and TypeScript.
此处比较 @oclif/core，不是所有插件的能力合集。Shell 补全需 p: This entry compares @oclif/core, not every plugin combined. Shell completion requires plugin-autocomplete, and official UX guidance recommends Inquirer for prompts; these extensions are not core built-ins.
官方指南建议额外使用 Inquirer。: Official guidance recommends the additional Inquirer library.
Windows 3.7 预发布可填写已有文本、复选/单选和列表字段并保存；稳定下: Windows 3.7 pre-release can fill existing text, checkbox/radio and list fields and save them; the stable download is still 3.6.1. This does not establish stable-version or Web support, or automatic recognition of scanned forms.
支持按时段和星期切换备用限速，默认关闭；此处不等同任意下载任务的定时启动或停止。: Supports scheduled alternate speed limits by time of day and day of week, disabled by default; this does not imply scheduled start or stop of arbitrary download tasks.
服务端图形录制需为连接配置 recording-path，未配置则不录制。即使已: Server-side graphical recording requires recording-path on the connection and is off without it. Even after capture succeeds, browser playback from connection history requires the recording storage extension and web app read access to the directory and file. Either the recording file directly in the configured search path or an immediate subdirectory containing it must be named after the history entry UUID.
